mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate lower borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment growth (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through their joint effect.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market recovery (HOUST > 1400 thousand units) and rising consumer credit (RSAFS > 680,000 million dollars), demand for goods strengthens, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or joint signal Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate indicates tightening labor market conditions that typically precede stronger consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to labor market strength.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as supply chain disruptions impact earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicates robust demand conditions that support corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through their interaction effect.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST rising and RSAFS rising fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 300), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive policy that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate prolonged tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 300, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
